notes: Fresh 2026-10-05 Toronto-morning B_V1 review of all 159 candidates and all 159 judge-review records. Applied entity-accuracy hard rejects, all five component scores, component thresholds, judge_score >=58 and semantic deduplication. Rejected numerous accidental ticker/common-word mappings (including GP, TGT, CCO, EMD, IMMR, CCF, SRG, ADC, SE, MS, RTX, RAM and others), evergreen/SEO commentary, generic forecasts, low-materiality items and duplicate rates/crypto/Google/Paramount angles. Selected 20 distinct eligible events ranked primarily by judge score, then discovery/burst/freshness/evidence. No direct YouTube API calls were made.
